title: Gherkin: reference-links.feature and reference-related-ui.feature
description: features_backend/reference-links.feature: a human link is current with provenance; a suggestion is suggested and invisible to the graph; Accept/Reject flips state and records who and why; knee cut with no learned cut; Wilson cut once decisions exist; concept link counts in the concept report. features/reference-related-ui.feature: chips and cards have text labels; reject offers the reason box; add by hashtag.

comments.text: Covered by the merged features: features_backend/reference-links.feature (human link current with provenance, suggestion invisible to the graph, Accept/Reject records who and why, knee cut, Wilson cut, concept link counts in the concept report), features/reference-related-ui.feature (text labels beside marks, reason box, add by hashtag, both dates) and features/reference-link-resolvers.feature.
